memory_order: stable sort by retained strategy score descending, then frozen base generator order
causal_pass_rule: within the first 64 charged candidates, retained-memory arm passes and no-memory control arm does not; exact winner replay must pass
objective_freeze_rule: Issue body and source may be inspected only after this protocol is committed; evaluator must then be frozen before either arm is executed.
claim_boundary: A3 DEVELOPMENT only. A pass establishes causal search-prior reuse on one fresh external task, not general transfer or autonomous strategy invention.
